summary: Single 80 mm diameter, 10 mm wide wheel with a six-spoke disc, a central hub and a solid outer tire band. The product is sold as a pair, and this describes one wheel. The wheel axis is along z, and the part is centered at the origin.

mountingSurfaces.description: Flat hub face on the side where the shaft collet insert and motor mounting hub attach, around the central bore.
Opposite outer face of the wheel disc and tire.

notes: Only the 80 mm diameter and 10 mm width are stated, and the listing marks them as unverified. The central bore diameter (9 mm) is a rough scale estimate from the photo, not a printed value. The hub has additional small holes around the bore, and the images show no printed dimensions for them, so I left them out. The 3 mm and 4 mm collet inserts (round and D-shaped) fit into the hub. The images give no collet dimensions, and the listing gives no shaft or bore dimensions. The wheel's overall z extent assumes the 10 mm width covers the whole tire and hub.
